text.p: These are the leading stories in the Moroccan press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Morocco celebrates 68th birthday of King Hassan.

- Prime Minister Abdellatif Filali calls on European Union to help Morocco in developing its northern provinces, with planned projects totalling 15 billion dirhams ($1.58 billion) between 1997 and 2001.
- Two Spaniards, arrested at Casablanca airport with hashish, each sentenced to six years' imprisonment for drug trafficking.
- Crown Prince Mohammed inaugurates domestic private air carrier, Regional Air Lines.

- Compagnie Nord Africaine et Intercontinentale d'Assurances (CNIA) sold to private enterprise, with Arab Insurance Group taking 67 percent of the 78.57 percent stake offered by the state at 310.2 million dirhams. Two Moroccan companies share remainder.
- More than 36,000 Moroccan expatriates return through Tangier port in June for summer holidays.
